newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates drop to 20.375 pct in liquid mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates drop to 20.375 pct in liquid mkt.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates dropped to 20.375 percent on Tuesday in a liquid marketabundant money supply and were unlikely to exceed 21 percent in the next few days, traders said.
"Overnight rates would probably move between 20.50 and 20.75 percent in the next days," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank.
She added that today's quarterly VAT payments did not have a strong impact in the very liquid market.

Another trader also said the money supply was more than adequate but was uncertain whether present low market quotes would prompt players to put excess funds into the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility, now standing at 21 percent.
"I would wait until Wednesday to see what happens," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
